name: smarter-compact
description: Context management (smart compaction): long sessions under a token limit without an LLM summary; trimmed turns stay in a local SQLite store the agent can search.

plugins.name: smarter-compact
plugins.description: Drops older turns from the model request once the prompt crosses a token threshold, keeps them verbatim, and exposes smart_compact_search, smart_compact_sql, and smart_compact_get.
